title: Pablo Exclusive Strawberry Cheesecake Nicotine  Pouches - 30mg / Pouch
description: Pablo Strawberry Cheesecake Nicotine Pouches combine sweet, fruity Strawberry with a creamy dessert finish for a flavour that’s indulgent and satisfying. This is a distinctive choice for those looking for something different to the usual mint or fruit blends. Each pouch delivers 30mg of nicotine in a slim, tobacco-free format designed for discreet, smoke-free use. These pouches fit comfortably under the lip and begin releasing nicotine within seconds, offering up to 30 minutes of steady satisfaction. Packaged in a sleek and portable can containing 20 pouches, Pablo Strawberry Cheesecake is a bold and memorable flavour experience for adult nicotine users. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a consistent nicotine release for up to 60min 2 Place the used pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH Please Note: These nicotine pouches are 30mg of nicotine per pouch.
